item.title: In 2013, St Agnes and Gugh began rat eradication; 12 yrs later, Manx shearwater sites hit record 225
item.description: A rat eradication project on St Agnes and Gugh in the Isles of Scilly began in 2013 after invasive brown rats were found to be threatening nesting seabirds. The islands have remained rat-free since the operation, while Manx shearwater breeding numbers have increased from 22 pairs before eradication to 225 apparently occupied breeding sites recorded in 2025. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.description: In 2026, Buffalo's Tifft Nature Preserve proudly commemorates its 50th anniversary, evolving from a former landfill into a 264-acre ecological haven. The tireless restoration work has resulted in stunning wetlands, lush woodlands, and diverse wildlife ecosystems. item.title: Second Phase Of Easement: Montana pursues $17.1mn timberland deal; public can weigh in by September 26
item.description: Montana officials are proactive in their efforts to conserve approximately 48,000 acres of private timberland. This proposed conservation easement is designed to halt future development while permitting ongoing timber activities. The initiative aims to preserve wildlife habitats and maintain public access for recreation. A multimillion-dollar funding approach consists of various state and federal stakeholders, and they are currently inviting public feedback prior to making a conclusive decision.
